criteria.description: Synthetic tile extraction is deterministic, bounded, and resumable.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_08/test_pathology.py; extraction commits chunk files and finalizes atomically.

criteria.description: Embedding stores preserve aligned metadata and support subset reads.
criteria.evidence: HDF5 store tests and EmbeddingStoreReader HDF5 round-trip pass.

criteria.description: Mean pooling and attention MIL ignore padded tiles.
Selectors enforce deterministic tile and fixed visual-token budgets.

criteria.description: Cached embeddings support classifier backward and pathology VLM token bridging.
criteria.evidence: Smoke performs a classifier backward; VLM bridge test verifies masked pooled output.

criteria.description: Pathology registry records and offline smoke plugins are present.
criteria.evidence: validate_phase checks H-Optimus, GigaPath-Flash, and TITAN records/plugins.

criteria.description: Upstream checkpoint and accelerator gates are fail-closed when external prerequisites are unavailable.
criteria.evidence: Registry license records remain blocking/pending; no real checkpoint or hardware result is claimed.
criteria.justification: The Phase 08 local adapter/store contract is complete. Real upstream weights and CUDA/TPU throughput remain governed by explicit unresolved issues rather than fabricated evidence.
